product_metadata.title: DWCN Amaranth Red Sheer Curtains Semi Transparent Voile Rod Pocket Curtains for Bedroom and Living Room, 52 x 45 inches Long, Set of 2 Panels
features: These curtains are made of 100% durable imported polyester and luxurious textured weave sheer fabric, your package includes 2 panels, each panel measures 52 x 45 inches long.

Quality workmanship, no loose threads and stitching flaws, no wrinkles, consistent sizes, both sides sewn 0.6 inch, top hem is 4 inch , 3 inch rod pocket work well for standard rods in the market, your drapes will hung beautifully.
These hanging semi sheer curtains have a linen texture,filter the dazzling sunlight, let the soft light in, and these curtains still provide your privacy,different size and colors are available.
Faux linen design adds style and elegance to your room, provides a pretty soft and natural look to your windows, makes your room have a more luxurious look.
Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, do not bleach, tumble dry low, light iron as needed
